steps: Combine the white wine and saffron in a measuring cup and set aside to bloom.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the shallots, bell pepper, garlic, salt and pepper and saute until tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, smoked paprika and cumin and toast the spices, about 2 minutes.
Pour in the wine-saffron mixture and simmer until reduced by half, 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomato passata, broth, parsley and lemon zest. Bring to a rapid simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low, cover and cook until the chickpeas begin to soften, about 10 minutes.
Uncover and stir in the spinach until wilted. Nestle the fish fillets into the mixture, spoon sauce over them, season with salt and pepper and cover.
Poach until the fish flakes easily with a fork, 8-10 minutes.
Transfer the fish to plates and ladle the chickpeas around it. Serve with lemon wedges and red pepper flakes.
